context: A teacher walks a teen through a current-events project
purpose: Teach: をめぐって/促す/西欧/源泉/日本海/団結/結びつい/乏しい

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、漁業権をめぐって、地域の声、丁寧に拾えていますね。
lines.en: Sakura, you're doing a careful job of listening to what the community is saying about fishing rights.
lines.style: Warm approval with genuine interest. Open posture. Nodding slightly on the observation. Encouraging—the kind of teacher who makes a student want to keep thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。日本海側の漁師さん、西欧との比較に興味を示してます。
lines.en: Yes. The fishermen along the Sea of Japan coast are really interested in comparing their situation to what's happening in Western Europe.
lines.style: Focused and precise. She's thought this through. Slight lean forward—proud of the detail but not defensive. Natural cadence of someone sharing what they've learned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 魚の源泉が乏しい年、地域団結が試されますね。
lines.en: And in years when the fish stocks are thin, that's when the real pressure on regional unity shows up.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slight pause before the observation, like she's working through the logic aloud with Sakura. Steady eye contact. Affirming the deeper pattern she sees.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 若手の参加を促す自治体の取り組みも、強く結びついています。
lines.en: The local government programs that are trying to get younger people involved are tied into all of this too.
lines.style: Building conviction with each phrase. She's connecting threads. Slight intensity on "tied in"—this matters. Not lecturing, but thinking alongside her teacher. Voice rises slightly with discovery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 素晴らしい着眼点です。
lines.style: Genuine, warm. Quiet satisfaction in her voice. A beat of silence before the sentence, like she's registering the quality of Sakura's thinking. Not performance—real recognition.
